badge.uploading: Saving {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}…
badge.waiting: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} saved on this device, will upload when online
badge.problem: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} couldn't be saved
badge.otherAccount: Changes from another account are waiting on this device
badge.superseded: Not uploaded: {name} took over scoring at {time}
badge.allSavedToast: All your match data is saved to the server
badge.noIssues: Everything recorded on this device is on the server.

errors.rls: The server refused this change (no permission).
errors.schema_mismatch: The app needs an update to save this change.
errors.duplicate: A conflicting record already exists on the server.
errors.reference_missing: Something it refers to ({table}) was deleted on the server.
errors.deleted_on_server: This record was deleted on the server.
errors.parent_rejected: It depends on a {table} that couldn't be saved.
errors.too_many_attempts: It couldn't be saved after repeated attempts.

claim.takenTitle: Someone else is scoring this match
claim.takenBody: {name} is scoring this match on {device} (last data received at {time}).
claim.takenWarning: If you take over, changes that device hasn't uploaded yet won't be saved.
claim.offlineBody: You're offline, so the app can't check whether someone else is scoring this match. Score on this device?
claim.takenOverBanner: Scoring was taken over by {name} on {device} at {time}.
claim.takeBackBody: Changes this device recorded but never uploaded before {name} took over will be discarded, and this device will show the match as it is on the server.
claim.forbiddenBody: Only the owner of one of the two teams can record this match.

guards.signOutBody: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} from this device haven't been uploaded. They stay on this device and upload when you sign back in.
guards.clearBlocked: Some of this data hasn't been uploaded yet. Wait until the sync badge shows “All saved”.
guards.resetBlocked: The local database still has changes that haven't been uploaded, so it wasn't reset. Go back online and wait until everything is saved.
